title: iris calabra
intro: Iris calabra, commonly known as the Rock Iris, is a species of flowering plant in the family Iridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Iris calabra include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of various skin conditions, such as eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of Iris calabra include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
